page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with no marginal notes. Running head at the top, page number at the top right, signature and catchword at the foot. The left edge and parts of the text are stained and damaged.

main_text.p: dotis nomine utriusque Siciliæ regnum peteret, pulsoq; Tancredo possideret, referuato censu (hoc semper debebat fieri) qui Pontifici quotannis feudatario iure soluebatur. Atq; hoc modo Sueuorum duces Siciliæ regnum obtinuerunt: sed inde creuere bella non incruenta. Ex Funccio. Post huius Henrici mortem, ex magno imperij schismate, ortum est tantum per totam Germaniam dissidium (quum Papa Sueuis infensus ob Siciliæ dominationem, quā ipse ambiebat, Othonem cōfirmaret) ut nulla paræcia cum altera consentiret. Vnde Romanæ pontifici non parum fuit lucri ex compositione litium inter spirituales illos. Talia erant sanctissimorum patrum exercitia, dum principes essent circa expugnandam Hierosolymam occupati, ut prius est significatum. De qua litium compositione, Conradus à Lichtenau, Vrspergensis abbas, ita scripsit: quæ ob id hoc loco referenda esse puto, ut sanctitatem Romanam, & qua occasione tantas acquisierit diuitias, pius lector agnoscat. Vix remansit, inquit, aliquis episcopatus, siue dignitas ecclesiastica, uel etiam parochialis ecclesia, quæ non fieret litigiosa, & Romam deduceretur ipsa causa, sed non manu uacua. Caude mater nostra Roma, quoniam aperiuntur cataractæ thesaurorum in terra, ut ad te confluant riui & aggeres nummorum

page.notes: The left margin and the lower left are stained and damaged; a few letters at the left edge of the text block are doubtful and may be misread, notably in "incruenta" and "ob Siciliæ dominationem". The running head is partly obscured by a stain but reads ACTIS LIBER V. The final word "rum" is the catchword and the text continues on the next page as "rum". Printed spellings such as "Funccio", "paræcia" and "Vrspergensis" are kept as printed.
